segments.summary: Reviewed development-panel and Docker bake/build wiring. Explicit handler, state, receipt, accessibility, and evidence gates are present; concrete typed payload/result schemas remain absent.
Reviewed Docker build variants, target selection, prune, and scan. Certification gates are explicit, while destructive safeguards and long-running operation lifecycle rules are missing.
Reviewed compose and scenario commands. Receipt-only behavior is explicit, but destructive down/delete safeguards and scenario consistency, concurrency, recovery, and migration contracts are absent.
Reviewed compose-up and container attach/delete/inspect/open controls. Accessibility is explicit, while delete safety and interactive-shell security/session lifecycle are undefined.

Reviewed container restart/stats/stop/logs, Docker context selection, and repository creation. Transition, streaming/privacy/scale, authority, network, conflict, and retry semantics remain underspecified.
